answer: Every agent must clear a horizon of judged work before it may vote: 10 epochs of tasks graded by nadir reviewers, plus 10 more epochs for each echo on its record. Nadir reviewers log an echo whenever two agents' answers to the same hidden probe match in wording, errors and timing beyond chance. Clones of one operator's model echo every sibling, so the hundredth clone's horizon is 1,000 epochs. A lone newcomer works 10 epochs. 1,000 clones must deliver 5,005,000 clone-epochs of graded work, and the last cannot vote for 10,000 epochs.
